title: 第1028章 瞬息尸潮由内爆发第1027章 棋局反转真正攻势
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
苏墨的神识扫过内城区的每一条街道、每一栋建筑、每一个还在喘息的生命。
一切正常。
城墙上的守备军依旧在巡逻，灵能屏障的幽蓝光芒依旧在夜空中稳定流转，星港商会的护卫队依旧守在物资仓库门前，佣兵行会的突击队员们三三两两靠在墙根下抓紧时间休息。
没有任何异常。
但正是这种“一切正常”
，让苏墨的脊背骤然绷紧。
黑袍虚影不会无缘无故留下一句传音。
古青殿不会大费周章地侵蚀封印外围禁制，只为了引他离开白帝城片刻。
他们一定做了什么。
只是他还没有发现。
“林团长？”
白无尘气喘吁吁地追了上来，他的速度远不及苏墨，从封印空间一路急奔回来，脸色又白了几分，“到底出了什么事？”
苏墨没有回答。
他的神识开始向内城区更深处渗透，从地面向下，穿过土层、岩层、地下管道、废弃的灵能井，一直延伸到地下数十里的深度。
然后他看到了。
内城区地下约三十里处，有一层极薄极淡的灰白色薄膜，正在缓缓向上渗透。
不是丝线网络那种粗壮的、肉眼可见的菌丝结构，而是一种以单个灵能病毒为单位的扩散层。
它不聚集，不结网，不形成任何肉眼可见的结构。
每一个灵能病毒都在独立行动，彼此之间保持着精确到令人胆寒的间距，均匀地分布在整片内城区的地底，如同一张精心编织的死亡之网。
它在等待。

等待一个触发信号。
苏墨的瞳孔收缩到了极致。
母巢的丝线网络是定向进化的死胡同，黑袍虚影说那是失败品。
他没有说谎。
他只是没说全。
母巢确实是失败品，但它在被摧毁之前，已经完成了它的实验使命——测试尸鬼病毒在封闭环境中的进化上限。
而那些测试数据，被用来优化了新一代的病毒。
不需要丝线网络，不需要母巢核心，不需要任何集中控制。
新一代尸鬼病毒是彻底去中心化的。
每一个灵能病毒都是一个独立的感染单元，拥有完整的感染、复制、变异能力，同时又能通过某种苏墨尚未解析的机制保持协同。
它们不需要母巢来指挥，因为它们每一个都是母巢的缩小版。
而这张由数万亿个独立病毒单元组成的死亡之网，已经在不声不响中覆盖了整座内城区的地底。
只差一个触发信号。
苏墨猛然抬头。
触发信号是什么？
黑袍虚影为什么要留那句传音？
他留传音，不是因为无聊，而是为了确认苏墨已经回到了白帝城。
苏墨回到白帝城的这一刻，就是触发信号。
“所有人——”
苏墨的声音刚出口，整座白帝城的地面骤然震颤。
content_en:
Su Mo's consciousness swept through every street, every building, and every breathing life in the inner city.
Everything works fine.
The garrison on the city wall is still patrolling, the blue light of the psychic barrier is still flowing steadily in the night sky, the guards of the Starport Chamber of Commerce are still guarding the door of the material warehouse, and the commandos of the mercenary guild are leaning against the wall in twos and threes to seize the time to rest.
Nothing unusual.
But it is this "everything is normal"
, making Su Mo's back suddenly tense.
The black-robed shadow will not leave a message without any reason.
Gu Qingdian would not go to great lengths to erode the outer restrictions of the seal, just to lure him away from Baidi City for a moment.
They must have done something.
But he hasn't discovered it yet.
"Captain Lin?"
Bai Wuchen caught up with him panting. His speed was far slower than Su Mo. He rushed back from the sealed space, his face turned a little pale again, "What happened?"
Su Mo didn't answer.
His consciousness began to penetrate deeper into the inner city, from the ground down, through soil layers, rock layers, underground pipes, abandoned spiritual energy wells, and extended to a depth of dozens of miles underground.
Then he saw it.
About thirty miles underground in the inner city, there is an extremely thin and light gray-white film that is slowly seeping upward.
Not the thick, visible mycelial structure of a network of threads, but a diffuse layer of individual psychic viruses.
It does not clump, web, or form any visible structure.
Each psychic virus acts independently, maintaining frighteningly precise spacing between each other, and is evenly distributed underground throughout the inner city, like a carefully woven web of death.
It's waiting.
Wait for a trigger signal.
Su Mo's pupils shrank to the extreme.
The silk network of the mother nest is a dead end for directed evolution, and the black-robed shadow said it was a failure.
He didn't lie.
He just didn't tell the whole story.
The Brood was indeed a failure, but before it was destroyed, it had completed its experimental mission—to test the evolutionary upper limit of the ghoul virus in a closed environment.
And those test data were used to optimize a new generation of viruses.
There is no need for a network of threads, no need for a brood core, no need for any centralized control.
The new generation of ghoul virus is completely decentralized.
Each psychic virus is an independent infection unit, with complete infection, replication, and mutation capabilities, and at the same time can maintain coordination through some mechanism that Su Mo has not yet analyzed.
They don't need a brood to command them, because each of them is a smaller version of the brood.
And this web of death, composed of trillions of independent virus units, has silently covered the underground of the entire inner city.
Only one trigger signal is missing.
Su Mo suddenly raised his head.
What is the trigger signal?
Why did the black-robed shadow leave that message?
He left a message not because he was bored, but to confirm that Su Mo had returned to Baidi City.
The moment Su Mo returned to Baidi City was the trigger signal.
"Everyone—"
As soon as Su Mo's voice came out, the ground in Baidi City suddenly trembled.
